description: Destructive: remove a receiving domain. All mail to it stops, including replies to emails already sent with reply addresses on it, and a branded inbox address on it is cleared. Confirm with the user first. Owner or admin only.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

domain.description: Receiving domain name, e.g. support.acme.com, or its receiving domain ID.

name: remove_receiving_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `remove_receiving_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

receivingDomain.description: The receiving domain that was removed. Mail to it no longer arrives.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
